title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation with LangChain
learning_objectives: Implement the Embeddings interface and index documents in InMemoryVectorStore
Retrieve context for a question and build a grounded prompt with source ids
Check that an answer cites only the retrieved sources
entry_point: class KeywordEmbeddings(Embeddings); build_store(docs, vocabulary); rag_answer(store, model, question, k=2)
hints: Count words with a dict over the vocabulary; the norm is `math.sqrt(sum(v * v for v in counts))`.
Citations: `re.findall(r"\[([\w-]+)\]", answer)`, keeping the first occurrence of each.

failure_feedback.advice: Count vocabulary words, L2-normalise, and keep an all-zero vector as zeros.
Add the texts with ids=list(docs) and search with similarity_search.
Grounded means at least one citation and every cited id was retrieved.
List each cited id once, in order of first appearance.
